headline: 5 well(s) carry an AFE of USD 5,829,200; USD 4,462,840 (77%) has been recorded.
At current spending rates the wells are forecast to close near USD 6,561,701, USD 732,501 over the combined AFE.
3 critical and 7 warning finding(s) need attention, mainly on WELL-B, WELL-D, WELL-C.
Cost above AFE, recorded or forecast, totals USD 778,296.

wells.summary: WELL-B has recorded USD 1,250,584 against an AFE of USD 1,270,800 (98%). At the current rate it is forecast to finish near USD 1,578,566, 24% over the AFE. Main points: forecast to finish 24% over the afe; daily cost has been creeping up since 2026-10-26; services is over its afe allowance.

WELL-D has recorded USD 1,185,601 against an AFE of USD 877,200 (135%). It is past its planned duration and is spending about USD 46,051 a day. Main points: actual cost is 35% over the afe; services is over its afe allowance; non-productive time is 11% of the cost.

WELL-C has recorded USD 1,021,327 against an AFE of USD 1,205,200 (85%). At the current rate it is forecast to finish near USD 1,367,328, 13% over the AFE. Main points: unusually high daily cost on 2026-11-07; forecast to finish 13% over the afe; 2 cost date(s) have no daily sheet.

WELL-A has recorded USD 1,005,328 against an AFE of USD 1,402,000 (72%). At the current rate it is forecast to finish near USD 1,356,205, 3% under the AFE. No cost or schedule concern was found; there are record-keeping notes only.
WELL-E has no recorded cost yet. No concern was found.

methods: Unusual days: each day's cost is compared with the median of up to 7 days either side using a modified z-score (median and MAD). A day is flagged beyond 3.5, at least 25% from that median, and only when no neighbouring day comes within 15% of it, so a step to a new level or a recurring peak is not reported.

Cost trend: Page's two-sided CUSUM on daily cost, standardised against the median of the well's opening period (slack 0.5, limit 4). It detects a sustained change of level that no single day would reveal.
Forecast: recorded cost plus the mean of the last 7 recorded days (unusual days excluded) for each remaining planned day. The range reflects the recent day-to-day spread (80% band).

Record quality: every date between the first and last cost date should have a sheet; identical totals on three or more consecutive days, zero-cost sheets, draft sheets and kept entry-check warnings are listed.
Health score: 100 less 25 per critical finding, 10 per warning and 3 per note, never below 0. The workspace score is the AFE-weighted average of its wells.
All findings are advice. Nothing is changed or blocked, and every finding states the rule and the figures used.

All depths are standardized to metres (feet / 3.281), and each section's actual depth uses the last depth value entered in the daily cost register.
